metadata.case_name: YEUNG TSZ MAN v. EVERBEST PORT SERVICES LTD (IN LIQUIDATION)

injuries.description: Angulated fracture of the middle phalanx of left ring finger
source: a 1.5 cm laceration with active bleeding and swelling was noted over his left ring finger. X-ray examination revealed an angulated fracture of the middle phalanx on his left ring finger.

injuries.description: Open wound / laceration over left ring finger
source: Physical examination revealed open wound over his left ring finger.
a 1.5 cm laceration with active bleeding and swelling was noted over his left ring finger.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of finger or thumb

injuries.description: Contusion of ulnar side neurovascular bundle (left ring finger)
source: Ulnar side neurovascular bundle was found contused, middle phalanx fracture was fixed with K-wire.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of ulnar nerve at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: Residual pain over his left ring finger
Numbness over his left ring finger
Stiffness of his left ring finger
Reduced and limited mobility of the left ring finger, in particular reduced left power grip and left power pinch grip
Aggravated pain during rainy and/or cold weather
Occasional sleep disturbance throughout the night due to pain and discomfort
Adverse effect on concentration and temper during the day
Reduced participation in outdoor activities such as playing basketball

treatments_received.treatment: Emergency operation with K-wire fixation of middle phalanx fracture
source: Emergency operation was performed on the same day. Ulnar side neurovascular bundle was found contused, middle phalanx fracture was fixed with K-wire.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for fracture of clavicle / hand / ankle / foot with internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: External splint for protection of fracture
source: An external splint was prescribed for protection of fracture.

treatments_received.treatment: Orthopaedic follow-up at Princess Margaret Hospital
source: After being discharged from hospital, the plaintiff had been receiving regular orthopaedic follow-up at Princess Margaret Hospital from 17September 2013 to 16May 2014.

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy (work rehabilitation program) at Princess Margaret Hospital - 4 sessions
source: he was referred to the Occupational Therapy Department of Princess Margaret Hospital for work rehabilitation program. He attended 4 sessions during the period from 13 September 2013 to 8 November 2013.

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy at Tuen Mun Hospital - 21 outpatient sessions
source: the plaintiff was referred to the Physiotherapy Department of Tuen Mun Hospital for treatment from 3 December 2013 to 15May 2014. He had attended 21 sessions of out-patient physiotherapy there.

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy at Tuen Mun Hospital - 19 sessions and work hardening training
source: He also attended 19 sessions of occupational therapy in Tuen Mun Hospital from 28 January 2014 to 15May 2014. He attended work hardening training. The final assessment result showed that he managed single arm lifting for 15 lb and bilateral lifting 12 kg metal bar for 10 minutes. The hand grip power was 25 kgf and 14 kgf at left and right sided respectively.

losses.description: Reduced and limited mobility of the left ring finger, in particular reduced left power grip and left power pinch grip

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Reduced time spent on outdoor activities such as playing basketball
Social life has been adversely affected
Concentration and temper during the day has been adversely affected
